best_idea: A health frame that draws one tick every fixed unit of hp, scales its full width to hp plus shield when shield overflows max, and eases each change over 150 ms, so the player counts ticks at a glance on a 375 px screen.
decision_why: Keep the tick-per-unit frame and the shield overflow rule for hero and enemy frames; fix the tween stacking (one live tween per field) and the stale max redraw; keep the tick size as one constant so a boss can use a bigger unit.
acceptance: At 375 px wide a 100-max enemy frame shows ticks at 25, 50 and 75 hp; a hero at 100/100 with 40 shield shows a 140-unit frame with ticks at 25 to 125 and a light strip after the hp fill; a unit test asserts the frame never exceeds its 68 px inner width and that two quick hp changes end on the second value.
